pages.text: $(thing)Barley Yellow Dwarf$() ($(o)Barley yellow dwarf virus (Luteoviridae)$()), virus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat, barley, oats, rye, maize, rice, sorghum.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() insect vector.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0.5 years (aphids on grasses).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 40% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Delay autumn sowing until aphid flights end; Control aphids; Tolerant varieties.$(br2)Spread only by aphids.
